paragraphs: In Chullin 48a: Mar Zutra son of Rav Huna son of Rav Pappi.[^1]

notes.text: The named William Davidson Chullin 48a paragraph explicitly gives Mar Zutra son of Rav Huna son of Rav Pappi. The source’s two Rav titles and the order of that chain are retained locally. This corroborates the wording of Hyman’s citation, without newly binding an authority or importing the paragraph’s other people or legal discussion.
